# You.com Skills

Skills that teach agents to work with You.com Skills. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [youdotcom-oss/agent-skills](https://github.com/youdotcom-oss/agent-skills), at commit `a692b6f`.

Search the web, read pages, research and look up finance data with You.com.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **You.com Skills**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **You.com Skills**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install youdotcom-agent-skills@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

5 skills: `you-discover`, `you-finance`, `you-free`, `you-research`, `you-web`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills use the `YDC_API_KEY` key or the vendor's MCP servers at `https://api.you.com/mcp`, which are not part of this plugin.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/youdotcom-oss/agent-skills
